## Use Nanum Gothic Coding in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Nanum Gothic Coding for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Nanum Gothic Coding', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the Nanum Gothic Coding coding font

A Korean programming font. Nanum Gothic Coding is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Nanum Gothic Coding is hosted on Google Fonts, so the specimen above renders without installing anything locally. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Nanum Gothic Coding FAQ

### Is Nanum Gothic Coding free?

Yes. Nanum Gothic Coding is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Nanum Gothic Coding support ligatures?

No. Nanum Gothic Coding has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Nanum Gothic Coding?

Nanum Gothic Coding is available from Google Fonts. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
